title: Export 9:16
script: 9:16 is the vertical video format. [Visual: phone screen]\nPerfect for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. [Visual: social apps]\nIt fills the entire mobile screen. [Visual: full screen]

title: Export 1:1
script: 1:1 is the square format. [Visual: square frame]\nGreat for Instagram feed and Facebook. [Visual: instagram]\nIt works well in both feed and stories. [Visual: feed preview]

title: Export 16:9

title: Multi-Aspect Export
script:
